source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Should this unit ever have no PINK HORROR models left, it switches to the BLUE HORRORS datasheet. Designer's note: as long as at least one PINK HORROR model remains in it, the BLUE HORRORS abilities Exploding Horrors and Sullen Malevolence are ignored for this unit.

detail.condition: unit contains no PINK HORROR models

designerNote.while: one or more PINK HORROR models in the unit
